topics.content:
BEM (Block-Element-Modifier) is a naming convention that prevents specificity wars and makes the relationship between classes explicit. ``` Block: Standalone component .card Element: Part of a block .card__title Modifier: Variant of a block .card--featured or element .card__title--truncated ``` ```html

``` ```css /* All selectors are single classes — maximum 0,1,0,0 specificity */ .card { } .card--featured { } .card__image { } .card__body { } .card__title { } .card__title--truncated { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } ``` Every rule is a single class. No nesting, no combinators, no specificity issues. Easy to reason about, easy to override. ---
